zh-CN.name: 缓动曲线
zh-CN.description: 缓动决定时间与进度的关系。它改变运动节奏，不等于改变持续时间。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
入场可考虑 ease-out，让开始较快、结束较慢；退出可考虑 ease-in。结合任务与距离观察效果，不把某条曲线当作高级设计的通用保证。
专属演示：两个实际运动对象以线性和所选缓动同步播放，行程与时长一致以便比较。 参数：选定缓动 {easing}；演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Easing
en.description: Easing maps elapsed time to animation progress. It changes pacing, not duration.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template:
Consider ease-out for entrances and ease-in for exits. Evaluate the curve in context; no single easing curve guarantees a premium design.
Dedicated demonstration: Two real moving objects play linear and selected easing together with equal distance and duration. Parameters: selected easing {easing}; demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
概念或实现参考，未复制外部正文与组件代码。
